<item>
      <title>The Bleeding Throne: Fratricide, Usurpation, and the Death of the First Dynasty</title>
      <description>Chapter 6 chronicles the violent implosion of Vijayanagara's first dynasty across four decades of fratricide, military losses, and systemic decay. Following Deva Raya the Second, the empire cycled through weak and murderous kings — sons killing fathers, brothers slaughtering brothers — while the Bahmani sultanate seized the western ports and a massacre of Muslim merchants at Bhatkal accidentally seeded the founding of Goa. The dynasty ends not with a foreign invasion but with a general named Narasimha, whose captain walks through unguarded city gates, enters an empty palace, and seizes the throne as the last king flees into the dark. Based on A Forgotten Empire (Vijayanagara) by Robert Sewell (1900).</description>
